# FinanceCalculator — Financial & multipurpose calculators

FinanceCalculator is a free bilingual (English / Russian) web app with path-based URLs for SEO.

## Site structure

- English home: /
- Russian home: /ru
- Calculators (EN): /interest, /loan, /mortgage, /deposit, /days, /vat, /emi, /bmi, /tax, /currency, /basic
- Same in Russian under /ru/ (e.g. /ru/interest)
- Blog index: /blog and /ru/blog
- Blog articles (examples): /blog/compound-interest-guide, /blog/mortgage-mistakes-down-payment-piti, … (see sitemap); Russian slugs under /ru/blog/…
- About: /about and /ru/about — Contact: /contact and /ru/contact

## What we offer

Scientific calculator; compound interest; savings/deposit projection; loan and mortgage amortization; date difference; VAT inclusive/exclusive; EMI; BMI (metric); simplified progressive tax illustration; currency conversion with demo rates.

## Important limitations

Results are educational estimates only-not financial, tax, medical, or legal advice. Currency rates in the app are illustrative, not live market quotes.

## Machine-readable discovery

- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- robots.txt: /robots.txt
